map.久期和凸性是什么关系？: What is the relation between duration and convexity?
map.久期是一阶近似（价格-利率斜率），凸性是二阶修正（曲线弯曲度）。小幅利率变动久期: Duration is a first-order approximation (the price-yield slope) and convexity is a second-order correction (the curvature). Duration suffices for small yield moves; for large moves a convexity term is needed.
map.先按每期票息与到期还本折现得债券价格；Macaulay 久期为现金流时间的加权平: First discount the per-period coupons and the principal at maturity to get the bond price; the Macaulay duration is the weighted average time of the cash flows (converted from per-period to per-year); convexity captures the second-order sensitivity of duration to interest rates and corrects the curvature of the price-yield curve.
map.免疫策略（duration matching）中比较两只债券的凸性。: Comparing the convexity of two bonds in an immunisation (duration matching) strategy.
map.利率大幅变动时，仅靠久期线性近似误差大，需要凸性修正。: For large yield moves the linear duration approximation has a big error, so a convexity correction is needed.
map.可赎回债、MBS 等含期权债券可能出现负凸性——利率下降时发行人行权，价格涨幅受: Callable bonds, MBS and other option-bearing bonds can show negative convexity: when rates fall the issuer exercises, which caps the price gain.

map.：对持有者，凸性越高，利率下降时涨价更多、上升时跌价更少（正凸性），是利好。但高: : for the holder, higher convexity means a bigger gain when rates fall and a smaller loss when they rise (positive convexity), which is good. But high convexity bonds usually have a low YTM.
